comment:
* Server socket class for zygote processes.
 *
 * Provides functions to wait for commands on a UNIX domain socket, and fork
 * off child processes that inherit the initial state of the VM.%
 *
 * Please see {@link ZygoteArguments} for documentation on the
 * client protocol.

variables.name: TAG
variables.comment: TODO (chriswailes): Change this so it is set with Zygote or ZygoteSecondary as appropriate

variables.name: INVALID_TIMESTAMP
variables.comment: The "not a timestamp" value for the refill delay timestamp mechanism.

variables.name: mUsapPoolEnabled
variables.comment:
* If the unspecialized app process pool should be created and used to start applications.
     *
     * Setting this value to false will disable the creation, maintenance, and use of the USAP
     * pool.  When the USAP pool is disabled the application lifecycle will be identical to
     * previous versions of Android.

variables.name: mZygoteSocket
variables.comment: * Listening socket that accepts new server connections.

variables.name: mUsapPoolSocket
variables.comment: * The name of the unspecialized app process pool socket to use if the USAP pool is enabled.

variables.name: mUsapPoolEventFD
variables.comment:
* File descriptor used for communication between the signal handler and the ZygoteServer poll
     * loop.
     *

variables.name: mCloseSocketFd
variables.comment:
* Whether or not mZygoteSocket's underlying FD should be closed directly.
     * If mZygoteSocket is created with an existing FD, closing the socket does
     * not close the FD and it must be closed explicitly. If the socket is created
     * with a name instead, then closing the socket will close the underlying FD
     * and it should not be double-closed.

variables.name: mIsForkChild
variables.comment: * Set by the child process, immediately after a call to {@code Zygote.forkAndSpecialize}.

variables.name: mUsapPoolSizeMax
variables.comment: * The runtime-adjustable maximum USAP pool size.

variables.name: mUsapPoolSizeMin
variables.comment: * The runtime-adjustable minimum USAP pool size.

variables.name: mUsapPoolRefillThreshold
variables.comment:
* The runtime-adjustable value used to determine when to re-fill the USAP pool.  The pool will
     * be re-filled when (mUsapPoolMax - gUsapPoolCount) >= sUsapPoolRefillThreshold.

variables.name: mUsapPoolRefillDelayMs
variables.comment:
* Number of milliseconds to delay before refilling the pool if it hasn't reached its
     * minimum value.

variables.name: mUsapPoolRefillAction
variables.comment: * If and when we should refill the USAP pool.

methods.name: void registerServerSocketAtAbstractName(String socketName)
methods.comment:
* Registers a server socket for zygote command connections. This opens the server socket
     * at the specified name in the abstract socket namespace.

methods.name: private ZygoteConnection acceptCommandPeer(String abiList)
methods.comment:
* Waits for and accepts a single command connection. Throws
     * RuntimeException on failure.

methods.name: protected ZygoteConnection createNewConnection(LocalSocket socket, String abiList) throws IOException
void closeServerSocket()
methods.comment:
* Close and clean up zygote sockets. Called on shutdown and on the
     * child's exit path.

methods.name: Runnable setUsapPoolStatus(boolean newStatus, LocalSocket sessionSocket)
methods.comment: * Empty or fill the USAP pool as dictated by the current and new USAP pool statuses.

methods.name: Runnable runSelectLoop(String abiList)
methods.comment:
* Runs the zygote process's select loop. Accepts new connections as
     * they happen, and reads commands from connections one spawn-request's
     * worth at a time.
     * @param abiList list of ABIs supported by this zygote.

methodNames: protected ZygoteConnection createNewConnection(LocalSocket socket, String abiList) throws IOException
